candidate.answerReason: Random selection among library visitors does not remove the bias caused by excluding other residents. Reading time may consequently be overestimated.

methods.label: Check coverage of the target population
methods.explanation: Sampling only people at a library entrance excludes many residents and does not give a representative sample of the city. People in this sample may read more, so the survey may overestimate average reading time; an overestimate is not guaranteed.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 reasoning about restricted sampling groups and possible selection bias.
